Package neqsim.process.engineering.safety

Class PhysicalInventorySafeguardingDesign

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.safety.PhysicalInventorySafeguardingDesign
public final class PhysicalInventorySafeguardingDesign extends Object
Converts a DYN-C029 physical inventory and declared operating limits into governed instrumentation and safeguarding proposals.

The study deliberately does not infer pipe routes, contained volumes, fail positions, SIL targets, voting, independence or approved set points. Numerical margins and response allocations come from an explicit PhysicalInventorySafeguardingDesign.DesignPolicy; plant geometry and isolation evidence come from the versioned plant_layout_physical_inventory.v1 document. Results are proposals for discipline review and carry no safety credit.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim development team
